title: A Bit of Relief: Tea and Toast

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hold on.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.zh: 我得感觉一下。

sentences.en: Okay, here we go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Kim Severson.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是金·瑟弗森。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Kim Severson.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是金·瑟弗森。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I just have to focus again.
sentences.zh: 我只是得重新集中注意力。

sentences.en: So I write about food for the New York Times, and I live in Atlanta, and I have a child, and I have a partner, and I have a house.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》撰写美食报道，我住在亚特兰大，我有一个孩子，一个伴侣，还有一套房子。

sentences.en: I cook 12 or 15 meals a day, it feels like.
sentences.zh: 感觉我一天要做12到15顿饭。

sentences.en: I do all the dishes, and I try to process being in this pandemic, which is crazy.
sentences.zh: 我包揽了所有的洗碗工作，并试图去适应身处这场疯狂疫情中的现实。

sentences.en: It's a lot in a day.
sentences.zh: 一天下来事情真多。

sentences.en: One thing I lose sight of is myself.
sentences.zh: 我最容易忽略的就是我自己。

sentences.en: So
sentences.zh: 所以

sentences.en: if I can, I take 10 minutes, slip away to the kitchen, and make myself a perfect cup of tea or a delicious little snack.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我会抽出10分钟，溜进厨房，为自己泡上一杯完美的茶，或者做一份美味的小点心。

sentences.en: And for me, the best thing is to make a perfect piece of cinnamon toaSt.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，最棒的事情就是烤一片完美的肉桂吐司。

sentences.en: Cinnamon toast is something you probably don't think about eating.
sentences.zh: 肉桂吐司可能是你平时不会刻意去想的美食。

sentences.en: I didn't think about eating, but all we're doing these days is thinking about eating.
sentences.zh: 我以前也没怎么想过要吃它，但我们这些天满脑子都在想着吃。

sentences.en: So I started with some bread, and it doesn't matter if it's like the squishy white bread you grew up with or a special kind of sourdough loaf you made yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我从一些面包开始，不管是你从小吃到大的那种软绵绵的白面包，还是你自己做的某种特殊的酸种面包都无所谓。

sentences.en: I have this piece of kind of dense white, very yeasty, sweet-smelling, almost brioche-like bread, which is perfect for cinnamon toaSt. It goes into the toaster.
sentences.zh: 我手里这块是那种质地紧密、酵母味浓郁、散发着甜香、几乎像布里欧修一样的面包，用来做肉桂吐司简直完美。它要进烤面包机了。

sentences.en: Now the thing is, you have to toast it so that it's just the right amount of brown, not too light and not too burnt.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，你得把它烤到刚刚好的棕色，不能太浅，也不能烤焦。

sentences.en: So you may have to run it through the toaster twice, but what else do you have to do besides babysit your cinnamon toast?
sentences.zh: 所以你可能得在烤面包机里烤两次，不过除了守着你的肉桂吐司，你还能做什么呢？

sentences.en: It's toasting.
sentences.zh: 正在烤呢。

sentences.en: We just sit here and wait for it to toaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们就在这儿等着它烤好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: I have a very awkward relationship with my toaster.
sentences.zh: 我和我的烤面包机有着一种非常尴尬的关系。

sentences.en: I can never pick exactly which number it needs to go on, so I'm constantly fidgeting with how long to toaSt. And it's still toasting.
sentences.zh: 我永远挑不准它到底该调到哪个数字，所以我总是在纠结该烤多久。它还在烤呢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: You know, I grew up with five kids in my family, and, you know, we didn't always have a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我家里有五个孩子，我们以前手头其实并不是很宽裕。

sentences.en: Sometimes we had a little more money than others, but my mother always would buy, you know, whatever that bread that the supermarket turned out in their bakery.
sentences.zh: 有时稍微好过一点，但我的母亲总是会买，你知道的，超级市场烘焙坊自己烤的那种面包。

sentences.en: It sort of has the allure of being home-baked.
sentences.zh: 它有点像是自家烘焙的诱惑。

sentences.en: I think she was trying to be slightly aspirational, you know, a little bit more than a loaf of Wonder Bread or Sundeem or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我想她当时是想追求一点生活品质，你知道的，比一整条旺达白面包或森迪姆面包稍微高级那么一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So the toast here is not quite how I want it.
sentences.zh: 这里的吐司还不是我想要的样子。

sentences.en: It's close, but we're going to have to put it in
sentences.zh: 差不多了，但我们得把它放进去

sentences.en: for another shot.
sentences.zh: 再烤一次。

sentences.en: Remember when we used to have restaurants, we had like ash, things coated in ash, and then charcoal was a, you know, flavor component.
sentences.zh: 还记得我们以前去餐厅的时候吗，有些东西上面裹着灰烬，当时木炭也是一种风味成分。

sentences.en: I don't like that in my cinnamon toaSt.
sentences.zh: 我可不希望我的肉桂吐司有那种味道。

sentences.en: So we're getting very close, almoSt. I think paint dry and watching toast toast are two things that are similar.
sentences.zh: 所以我们快要完成了，几乎好了。我觉得看油漆变干和看烤面包，是两件很相似的事。

sentences.en: However, I will say that this smells better than paint drying.
sentences.zh: 不过，我得说这闻起来可比油漆变干香多了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's toasty.
sentences.zh: 烤得很香脆。

sentences.en: It's just got a little dark around the edges.
sentences.zh: 边缘只是稍微有点黑。

sentences.en: And also the crust is, you can even hear that.
sentences.zh: 而且外皮，你甚至能听到这个声音。

sentences.en: That's a knife against the edge of the cruSt. It's actually sturdy enough.
sentences.zh: 那是刀子划过边缘的声音。其实它挺结实的。

sentences.en: And so now comes the butter application.
sentences.zh: 接下来就是涂黄油了。

sentences.en: And the thing is, I have to do this while it's warm, because if you wait too long, you're going to ruin the effect.
sentences.zh: 关键是，我必须在它还热的时候做这件事，因为如果你等太久，效果就毁了。

sentences.en: So you have to spread the butter on.
sentences.zh: 所以你得把黄油抹上去。

sentences.en: As soon as the toast is cool enough where you can hold it with the edge of your finger, then you start spreading on the butter.
sentences.zh: 等吐司凉到可以用指尖捏住的时候，你就可以开始抹黄油了。

sentences.en: You've got to be thick with the butter.
sentences.zh: 黄油下手要厚一点。

sentences.en: You want it to get melty and thick.
sentences.zh: 你要让它融化并且厚厚一层。

sentences.en: This is really no time to worry about your caloric intake or the possible health effects of eating this butter.
sentences.zh: 现在可不是担心卡路里摄入量或者吃这些黄油对健康有什么潜在影响的时候。

sentences.en: Because I think right now, the last thing that's going to be a problem for you health-wise is the butter on this toaSt. So just butter with complete abandon.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得现在，从健康角度讲最不需要担心的就是这吐司上的黄油了。所以就毫无顾忌地抹黄油吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then it kind of starts to soak into the bread and you want the butter to go all the way to the edge.
sentences.zh: 然后它开始渗入面包里，你得让黄油一直抹到边缘。

sentences.en: So then you have to have a perfect mix of cinnamon and sugar.
sentences.zh: 接着你得准备好完美比例的肉桂和糖。

sentences.en: Now, my mom used to have a shaker that had cinnamon sugar in it.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈以前有一个装肉桂糖的摇瓶。

sentences.en: So we could just, you know, kind of do it yourself when we came home from school.
sentences.zh: 所以我们放学回家后，就可以自己动手撒一点。

sentences.en: But I've mixed mine up perfectly, I think.
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得我调配的比例完美极了。

sentences.en: And then, and you want to go a little bit high when you sprinkle.
sentences.zh: 然后，撒的时候位置要稍微抬高一点。

sentences.en: You don't sprinkle too close to the toaSt. So you get a more even coating of the cinnamon.
sentences.zh: 别离吐司太近。这样肉桂才能撒得更均匀。

sentences.en: Sorry about that.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: I had a kitchen towel fail.
sentences.zh: 我刚才厨房擦手巾掉地上了。

sentences.en: I had reached over to get the kitchen towel because my fingers were buttery, but we're back.
sentences.zh: 我刚才伸手去拿厨房纸巾，因为我的手指沾满了黄油，不过我们回来了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So now it seems like a lot of fuss for cinnamon toaSt. Okay.
sentences.zh: 所以现在看来，为了一片肉桂吐司搞出这么大动静好像有点小题大做。好吧。

sentences.en: The thing about the cinnamon toast is that one bite and I am exactly back in my mom's kitchen after school.
sentences.zh: 肉桂吐司的妙处就在于，只要咬上一口，我就瞬间回到了放学后妈妈的厨房。

sentences.en: And I feel completely safe and happy.
sentences.zh: 我感到无比的安全和快乐。

sentences.en: And that's really, that's really all I'm looking for right now.
sentences.zh: 而这，真的是我目前唯一在寻找的东西。

sentences.en: Safe, happy, and delicious.
sentences.zh: 安全、快乐，还有美味。

sentences.en: My mom died a few years ago and I've really thought about
sentences.zh: 我妈妈几年前去世了，我经常在想

sentences.en: what she'd say about the current situation we find ourselves in.
sentences.zh: 对于我们现在所处这种状况，她会说些什么。

sentences.en: And I find myself talking to her.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己经常在跟她对话。

sentences.en: And so I get to have this little piece of cinnamon toast and have a moment with my mom.
sentences.zh: 所以能吃上这么一小片肉桂吐司，和妈妈度过这样一段时光，让我觉得很珍贵。

sentences.en: I'm going to cry now.
sentences.zh: 我现在要哭了。

sentences.en: I know I'm like crying now.
sentences.zh: 我知道我这会儿就像在哭一样。

sentences.en: Jesus.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That's true though.
sentences.zh: 不过这是真的。

sentences.en: You know, I've been thinking about her, what she would think about all this, you know, something.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我一直在想她，想她会对这一切怎么看，你知道的，类似的话。

sentences.en: She, um, you know, grew up in, she was a kid of Italian immigrants, grew up on a farm that didn't have electricity for a while.
sentences.zh: 她，嗯，你知道的，生长在——她是意大利移民的孩子，在一个有一段时间甚至通不上电的农场长大。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that, uh, she would tell me to count my blessings and just get on with it.
sentences.zh: 我确信，呃，她会告诉我要知足常乐，别想那么多，过好日子就行。

sentences.en: So maybe not the coziest thing, but that's pretty much what she would say, just like, get your shit together.
sentences.zh: 所以这或许算不上多温馨，但差不多就是她会说的话，就像是，振作点，别整天垂头丧气的。

sentences.en: And then the other thing that she would always tell me to do is, uh, is go find somebody else who has less than you and help them out.
sentences.zh: 然后她总是嘱咐我做的另一件事是，呃，去寻找那些比你过得还不如的人，然后去帮助他们。

sentences.en: And so, um, maybe you can go make someone who's feeling badly a piece of toast today.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，也许你今天也可以给某个心情不好的人做一片吐司。

sentences.en: Oh, I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 哦，我累了。

sentences.en: Do I have to like send you a check for this therapy or are we okay?
sentences.zh: 我是不是得给你寄张看心理医生的支票，还是我们这样就行了？

sentences.en: Shit.
sentences.zh: 该死。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm done.
sentences.zh: 我录完了。

sentences.en: This is not easy.
sentences.zh: 这可真不容易。

sentences.en: Um, okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧。

sentences.en: The only thing that would make this better is a perfect cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 唯一能让这一切更完美的，就是一杯完美的茶。

sentences.en: And no one is more obsessed about their tea than the Brits.
sentences.zh: 没有人比英国人更对茶有着狂热的执着了。

sentences.en: And we have the perfect Brit.
sentences.zh: 而我们刚好有一位地道的英国人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I think we can go and this now should, should all record for posterity.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们可以开始了，接下来的这些应该，都应该作为历史资料记录下来。

sentences.en: My boss's boss's boss's boss, Mark Thompson.
sentences.zh: 我老板的老板的老板的老板，马克·汤普森。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: I'm going to stop this.
sentences.zh: 我要把这个停了。

sentences.en: My name is Mark Thompson.
sentences.zh: 我叫马克·汤普森。

sentences.en: I'm the chief executive of the New York Times company.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》公司的首席执行官。

sentences.en: And as you can hear, I'm, I'm a Brit, um, or to be more exact, half British, half Irish.
sentences.zh: 正如你所听到的，我，我是一个英国人，嗯，或者更准确地说，一半英国血统，一半爱尔兰血统。

sentences.en: And what that means is, um, when we're looking for comfort, you know, we have great literature,
sentences.zh: 这意味着，嗯，当我们寻求慰藉时，你知道的，我们有伟大的文学作品，

sentences.en: we have great music, we have all of those things, of course, but what we turn to more than anything else is a nice cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我们有伟大的音乐，当然还有所有这些，但我们最依赖的还是那杯香浓的茶。

sentences.en: And so I thought I'd take, teach you, get up.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要教你，起来。

sentences.en: Um, uh, uh, don't let you, I swear like a trooper.
sentences.zh: 嗯，呃，呃，别让你觉得，我满嘴脏话。

sentences.en: So, um, I'll do the last bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我来收尾吧。

sentences.en: Hot tea got my country through two world wars.
sentences.zh: 热茶曾支撑我的国家度过了两次世界大战。

sentences.en: I have to tell you now, this country is at war with Germany.
sentences.zh: 我现在必须告诉你们，这个国家正与德国交战。

sentences.en: End of the British empire, the breakup of the Beatles.
sentences.zh: 大英帝国的终结，甲壳虫乐队的解散。

sentences.en: Who broke it up?
sentences.zh: 是谁解散的？

sentences.en: John.
sentences.zh: 约翰。

sentences.en: John did.
sentences.zh: 是约翰。

sentences.en: The 2008 financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 2008年金融危机。

sentences.en: The world's central banks act together to slash intereSt.
sentences.zh: 世界各国央行联手大幅降息。

sentences.en: And yes, even that recent spot of bother with Harry and Meghan.
sentences.zh: 是的，甚至还有最近哈里和梅根的那点风波。

sentences.en: A deal has been agreed on the future of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex.
sentences.zh: 关于苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人的未来，双方已经达成了一项协议。

sentences.en: So it should be able to get you through the coronavirus too.
sentences.zh: 所以它应该也能帮你们挺过冠状病毒危机。

sentences.en: The spine of the day, um, in many ways is tea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在很多方面，茶就是日子的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: And it begins in the morning with, with breakfast tea, which means quite a strong, punchy black tea.
sentences.zh: 它从早晨的早茶开始，这意味着相当浓郁提神的红茶。

sentences.en: We've got a range of teas.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多种茶。

sentences.en: We can introduce you to the teas and, uh, uh, and I'll go through the process, which, which of course begins with, with water.
sentences.zh: 我们可以向你介绍这些茶，呃，呃，然后我会讲解整个过程，这个过程当然是从水开始的。

sentences.en: So we're just, just going to add the, the waters of the kettle.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要把水倒进水壶里。

sentences.en: It's an obvious point, but I'll make it anyway.
sentences.zh: 这是一个显而易见的道理，但我还是要说。

sentences.en: It wants to be fresh water.
sentences.zh: 必须是新鲜的水。

sentences.en: Don't live with the, the water you've already got in the kettle.
sentences.zh: 别用壶里已经存着的水。

sentences.en: Pour it out, start from scratch.
sentences.zh: 倒掉它，重新开始。

sentences.en: You want it to be absolutely fresh water.
sentences.zh: 你一定要用绝对新鲜的水。

sentences.en: Quite honestly, one of the most disheartening things about American life is not the politics, not the incredible social division.
sentences.zh: 老实说，美国生活中最令人沮丧的事情之一，不是政治，也不是不可思议的社会分裂。

sentences.en: It's the way so many of you make tea.
sentences.zh: 而是你们当中那么多人的泡茶方式。

sentences.en: Here's a scenario.
sentences.zh: 我们来看这样一个场景。

sentences.en: You walk into a fancy hotel or a restaurant and, uh, you order, you order a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 你走进一家高级酒店或餐馆，然后呢，你点了一杯茶。

sentences.en: The waiter brings it.
sentences.zh: 服务员端了上来。

sentences.en: And what comes is a glass, which is full of kind of tepid water.
sentences.zh: 端上来的却是一个杯子，里面装满了有点温吞的水。

sentences.en: And there's this thing, this kind of plastic pyramid, which isn't in the water.
sentences.zh: 旁边还有个东西，类似于塑料金字塔，它并没有泡在水里。

sentences.en: It's sitting on the side.
sentences.zh: 它就放在一旁。

sentences.en: The whole thing's getting cold.
sentences.zh: 整杯东西渐渐变凉了。

sentences.en: The bill's 10 bucks.
sentences.zh: 账单要10块钱。

sentences.en: And they, they obviously won a nomination for a James Beard award.
sentences.zh: 而且他们，他们显然还获得了詹姆斯·比尔德奖的提名。

sentences.en: So much of our, our life and indeed so much of the food we have is kind of instant.
sentences.zh: 我们的很多生活，甚至我们吃的大多数食物，其实都是那种即食的。

sentences.en: We expect it instantly.
sentences.zh: 我们希望它马上就能做好。

sentences.en: Tea's different.
sentences.zh: 茶则不同。

sentences.en: You have to wait for the tea.
sentences.zh: 泡茶是需要等待的。

sentences.en: The tea kind of happens on its time rather than your time.
sentences.zh: 茶有它自己的节奏，而不是顺应你的时间。

sentences.en: And there's something very pleasing to me about that, about a process.
sentences.zh: 而我觉得这一点非常美妙，也就是这样一个过程。

sentences.en: You know, it's not a natural process.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不是一个自然发生的过程。

sentences.en: It's a rather amazing human invention.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当了不起的人类发明。

sentences.en: The whole idea of curing tea leaves, preserving them, and then bringing them back to life with water is a, is a rather amazing human discovery.
sentences.zh: 制作茶叶、将其保存，然后用水让它们复活，整个概念是一项相当了不起的人类发现。

sentences.en: We want the water to be at a rolling boil when it hits the tea leaves.
sentences.zh: 当水接触到茶叶时，我们希望水是处于沸腾状态的。

sentences.en: It wants to be really boiling.
sentences.zh: 它必须是真正沸腾的。

sentences.en: That's the thing that just jerks the tea back into life and makes it, makes it kind of zesty and, and, and, and delicious.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点让茶瞬间焕发生机，让它变得，变得很有风味，而且，而且，而且，而且非常美味。

sentences.en: Now I have to say there's an incredibly lively debate in this house about how much tea you actually put in.
sentences.zh: 现在我必须说，在这家里，关于到底该放多少茶叶，一直存在着一场极其激烈的争论。

sentences.en: The way I was taught by my beloved mother was one teaspoon per person and one for the pot.
sentences.zh: 我慈爱的母亲教给我的方法是：一个人放一茶匙，茶壶多放一茶匙。

sentences.en: So if it's two people, small teapot, you put in three teaspoons.
sentences.zh: 所以如果是两个人用的小茶壶，你就要放三茶匙。

sentences.en: My wife Jane thinks that's completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子简认为这完全大错特错。

sentences.en: It's far too strong and makes a kind of, kind of stewed, kind of bitter, bitter thing.
sentences.zh: 浓度太高了，泡出来会变成那种，有点像煮过头、苦涩不堪的东西。

sentences.en: I shouldn't set myself up as any kind of real tea expert.
sentences.zh: 我不该把自己标榜为什么真正的茶叶专家。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm not, but I did learn at the feet of a real tea expert, my, my mother.
sentences.zh: 我，我不是，但我确实曾向一位真正的茶叶专家讨教过，那就是我的母亲。

sentences.en: My mother was the ninth child of an Irish country policeman.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是一个爱尔兰乡镇警察的第九个孩子。

sentences.en: They lived in County Donegal.
sentences.zh: 他们住在多尼戈尔郡。

sentences.en: So lots of children, very little money.
sentences.zh: 所以孩子很多，钱却很少。

sentences.en: Um, and what, what really kept them going, and this was true of households all over England, Scotland, Wales, uh, and, and Ireland was tea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，真正支撑他们坚持下去的——英格兰、苏格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰各地的家庭也都是如此——就是茶。

sentences.en: What I've got here in my hand is a British supermarket, uh, blend.
sentences.zh: 我手里拿的这个，是英国超市里的一种混合茶。

sentences.en: It's rather beautiful tea, this one.
sentences.zh: 这种茶相当漂亮。

sentences.en: You can't see it, but it's, um, it's still discernible.
sentences.zh: 你们可能看不见，但是，嗯，它还是清晰可辨的。

sentences.en: I mean, some tea, sometimes tea is very, even very good tea.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有些茶，有时候茶是非常，哪怕是很好的茶。

sentences.en: It's very ground.
sentences.zh: 它被磨得很碎。

sentences.en: It's very small and very dense.
sentences.zh: 颗粒很小而且很密。

sentences.en: This has got lovely, um, you can still see the fibres of the leaves.
sentences.zh: 而这个很好，嗯，你依然能看到茶叶的纤维。

sentences.en: It's got a royal warrant from the Queen.
sentences.zh: 它拥有女王的皇家认证。

sentences.en: So who knows, maybe Her Majesty the Queen is, is bent over the stove in Windsor Castle, even now making this exact same cup of tea for Prince Philip.
sentences.zh: 所以谁知道呢，说不定女王陛下此时此刻正弯着腰在温莎城堡的炉灶旁，亲手为菲利普亲王泡这杯一模一样的茶呢。

sentences.en: Um, you can hear the kettle's boiling.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你能听到水壶在烧水。

sentences.en: So I'm just going to go and pour the water on the, over the tea leaves now.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要去把水倒在茶叶上了。

sentences.en: So we're going to get it right on to the tea leaves.
sentences.zh: 我们要直接把水浇在茶叶上。

sentences.en: And I think you put it on here, but that's pretty much boiling as it hits the, hits the tea.
sentences.zh: 我想你是倒在这里，水冲到茶叶上时，基本上已经全开沸腾了。

sentences.en: My particular way of doing, I'm going to turn the gas off and I'm going to give it one stir, put the lid on, and we're going to, uh, just leave that.
sentences.zh: 我个人的习惯是，我要关掉燃气，搅拌一下，盖上盖子，然后，嗯，就放在那里。

sentences.en: And we're going to leave that for five minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们要把它放在那里泡五分钟。

sentences.en: Uh, on a more serious note, I've decided to finally bite the bullet and work my way through the Bach cantatas of, of which there are 200.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说点严肃的，我决定一不做二休，把巴赫的清唱剧全听一遍，总共有200首呢。

sentences.en: I'm reading
sentences.zh: 我正在读

sentences.en: David Copperfield, which is absolutely fantastic.
sentences.zh: 《大卫·科波菲尔》，真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a fantastic national theatre production of, uh, one man, two governors, perhaps not his best novel, but it's so kind of luminous and it's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有一个国家剧院出品的精彩绝伦的单人喜剧《一仆二主》，它或许不是他最好的小说，但它是如此光芒四射，简直难以置信。

sentences.en: The greatest music ever written, written by one guy, comedy.
sentences.zh: 有史以来最伟大的音乐，由一个人创作，喜剧。

sentences.en: It's a Goldoni comedy, which is one of these, uh, you know, buildings for a man.
sentences.zh: 这是一部哥尔多尼式的喜剧，也就是那种，你知道的，为一个人搭建的桥段。

sentences.en: It's about a young man from childhood, making his way in the world.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了一个年轻人从童年起，在世界上闯荡的故事。

sentences.en: And I've always loved those books.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢这样的书。

sentences.en: So the tea's now been sitting for five minutes and we're going to pour it.
sentences.zh: 好了，茶已经泡了五分钟，现在我们要把它倒出来。

sentences.en: I've got a little rather nice sort of a tea strainer.
sentences.zh: 我有一个非常精致的小茶漏。

sentences.en: I'm going to pour it into the cup.
sentences.zh: 我要把它倒进杯子里。

sentences.en: Um, I'm going to put the strainer down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我要放下茶漏。

sentences.en: I've got some 2% reduced fat milk.
sentences.zh: 我有一些百分之二减脂牛奶。

sentences.en: I'm going to add the milk.
sentences.zh: 我要加点牛奶。

sentences.en: This is the tea, the way my wife likes it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我妻子喜欢的那种茶。

sentences.en: It's not quite as strong as I'd like, but it's got a quite a good colour to it.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有我想要的那么浓，但它的颜色相当不错。

sentences.en: Um, how would I describe the colour?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我该怎么形容这个颜色呢？

sentences.en: It's a sort of, it's very hard to describe.
sentences.zh: 这是一种，非常难以形容。

sentences.en: It's a kind of, probably not, I suppose, in the end, a very nice colour.
sentences.zh: 它是一种，最后想来大概并不算太坏的颜色吧。

sentences.en: It's a, it's a kind of putty colour with a little bit of orange in it, maybe.
sentences.zh: 它是一种，带有一点橙色的腻子色，也许吧。

sentences.en: It's very good tea.
sentences.zh: 这是非常好的茶。

sentences.en: That's very good tea.
sentences.zh: 这是非常好的茶。

sentences.en: It's, it's got a, it's got a freshness to it.
sentences.zh: 它，它有一种，它有一种新鲜感。

sentences.en: It's, um,
sentences.zh: 它，嗯，

sentences.en: it's light, it's quite flowery and it's got that briskness, that little kind of sizzle on the, on, on, um, it's almost like a kind of savoury sensation.
sentences.zh: 它很清淡，带有浓郁的花香，而且有一种爽口感，在，在，在，嗯，舌尖上有一种微弱的滋滋感，几乎就像是一种咸香的感觉。

sentences.en: It's not, it's not really a taste and it just speaks of something which is, which is fresh and alive.
sentences.zh: 它不是，它其实不是一种味道，它只代表着某种新鲜而充满活力之物。

sentences.en: And that's the, that's the, that's the miracle of tea.
sentences.zh: 这就是，这就是，这就是茶的奇迹。

sentences.en: It somehow comes back to blooming life, uh, um, on your tongue.
sentences.zh: 它不知怎么地，在你的舌头上重新焕发出了盛开般的生机。

sentences.en: So it's going to be some sips here followed by some sort of, um, uh, payoff thought.
sentences.zh: 所以这里要喝上几口，后面再配上某种，嗯，嗯，总结性的感悟。

sentences.en: What, what, what, what am I going to say to the, to the, to the, to the crowd?
sentences.zh: 我，我，我，我要对，对，对，对大众说些什么呢？

sentences.en: Um, hang on a second.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等一下。

sentences.en: Excellent.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: A case of whiners turned up.
sentences.zh: 一箱葡萄酒送到了。

sentences.en: Now you're talking.
sentences.zh: 这话说得对。

sentences.en: I'll do another episode on that.
sentences.zh: 我回头专门做一集讲讲这个。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Let's get back to this.
sentences.zh: 我们回到正题。

sentences.en: Um, um, right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，好吧。

sentences.en: So I'm just going to, okay, I'll just, I'll put a second cup.
sentences.zh: 那我这就，好吧，我再倒第二杯。

sentences.en: Um, um, that's been good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，嗯，这杯泡得很好。

sentences.en: One stir.
sentences.zh: 搅拌一次。

sentences.en: And I'm going to take another cup to my wife, Jenny, um, who's still in bed.
sentences.zh: 然后我要把另一杯茶端给我妻子珍妮，嗯，她还在床上。

sentences.en: Um, and she's reading, uh, Toni Morrison, A Song of Solomon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她在读，嗯，托妮·莫里森的《所罗门之歌》。

sentences.en: And I'm going to bring her a cup of tea, a nice cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我要给她端杯茶去，一杯好茶。

sentences.en: So that's a possible ending.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一个可能的结局。

sentences.en: Actually, I need to get back to my emails, but, uh, tea's going to make those emails go a little bit better.
sentences.zh: 其实，我得回去处理邮件了，不过，嗯，一杯茶能让那些邮件处理起来稍微顺畅一点。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听我们的节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I, I don't mean, do they black out to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 我，我不是指，他们是不是昏迷过去才睡着？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么过敏症或对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是爱喝咖啡还是爱喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
